name: synthetic-error-analytics
description: A referral program on an unpaid team. The other half of the plan gate, and also an account state. Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error, forces zero usage, and passes the envelope through — `code` is the stable half a caller branches on. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.

body.name: PaidPlanRequiredError
body.message: A paid plan is required to use the GrowSurf REST API for referral programs.
